text: ... for years now because of their long service & great workmanship. Never again. I've bought nothing but Lasko brand fans for years now because of their long service & great workmanship. Never again. This newest fan is a piece of absolute crap. Extremely lightweight, cheap construction, almost impossible to get the front on. Blades are very small & flimsy. The pole wobbles in the stand. I have low expectations for it.

product_metadata.title: Lasko FBA_2521 Oscillating Adjustable 16-inch Standing Pedestal Fan for Indoor, Bedroom, Living Room, Home Office & College Dorm Use, 1-Pack, Black Basic
features: WHAT A NICE BREEZE – Powered by 3 energy-efficient speeds, this 3-blade fan with electric plug-in motor moves a lot of air, even on the lowest setting. This simple-to-use, basic stand fan is a great value for creating a cooling breeze in both small and large household spaces.

BEAT THE SUMMER HEAT – If you live in the heat with no central air or have window AC units that do a poor job of moving air around your whole house or apartment, this fan easily brings comfort to the hottest rooms. Tilt-back head and optional oscillation directs the wind any way you want from floor to ceiling; making this fan a life saver when it’s hot & humid outdoors.Voltage (volts):120

EASY TO ASSEMBLE – No tools required. Assembles in minutes and is just as easy to take apart to clean. Pedestal fan is fully adjustable from 34 to 47 inches. Sturdy base occupies an 18” x 17” footprint on your floor to prevent tip overs. Lightweight and portable, it’s easy to move to provide relief wherever it’s needed.

WHITE NOISE FOR SLEEPING – If you need white noise to sleep, this fan creates a soothing purr that drowns out bedroom noises making it easy to fall asleep. It’s adjustable so it’s tall enough to aim over a high bed. It’s also quiet enough (especially on the lower settings) and strong enough to blow across the room to circulate the air so you can get some rest.

MADE IN THE USA – Built to last from domestic & imported parts and comes with all the right features you need to stay comfortable. ETL Listed and comes with Lasko’s patented 2-pronged Blue Plug safety fuse technology. A prime choice for the kitchen, garage, basement & home gym.
description: The Lasko 2521 is a black 16” oscillating adjustable pedestal fan. If it’s a nice breeze you seek, this basic, simple-to-use fan is a top pick for large and small spaces. Powered by 3 energy-efficient speeds, this 3-blade fan with electric plug-in motor is designed to move a lot of air-- even on the lowest setting. This powerful fan easily brings relief to hot household spaces to help you beat the heat. If you live where it’s hot & humid with no central air or have window AC units that do a poor job of moving air around your whole house or apartment, this stand fan is a real lifesaver. The tilt-back head and optional oscillation direct the wind any way you want, making this a great choice for cooling comfort. The fan assembles easily in minutes and requires no tools. It’s just as easy to take apart to clean. It’s fully adjustable, too. This standing fan adjusts from 34 to 47 inches tall. The sturdy base occupies an 18” x 17” floor footprint to prevent tip overs. Lightweight and portable, it’s easy to move from room to room to provide relief wherever needed. If you are the type that needs white noise to sleep, this floor fan is perfect for sleeping. Creates a soothing purr that drowns out the bedroom noises making it easy to fall asleep. This fan is tall enough to aim over a high bed, provides just the right amount of quiet white noise (especially on the lower settings), and strong enough to circulate air around the room so you can get some rest. Made in the USA and built to last from domestic & imported parts. Lasko fans are ETL Listed and come with our patented Blue Plug safety fuse technology, making them a great choice for use in the bedroom, living room, kitchen & more. Oscillation - Widespread oscillation
